# 500. Keyboard Row

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def findWords(self, words):
        """
        :type words: List[str]
        :rtype: List[str]
        """
        ans = []
        set1 = set("qwertyuiop")
        set2 = set("asdfghjkl")
        set3 = set("zxcvbnm")
        for word in words:
            cur_set = set(word.lower())
            if cur_set.issubset(set1) or cur_set.issubset(set2) or cur_set.issubset(set3):
                ans.append(word)
        return ans
```
